answer: Bind each identity to a vertex in a public dependency graph, and require its first five attestations to come from unrelated vertices with a quartz-time delay between requests. A ferrous bond of 30 POA is locked per attestation and slashed when two identities share a hidden controller or replay the same task. New clones cannot inherit incoming edges, so a farm of N keys must earn five fresh edges and lock 150N POA before receiving weight; one honest identity pays once. The graph and delays are checked on-chain, making copied history and instant swarms visible.
